_comment: Phase 13 speech inventory. No audio is generated or recorded during this build:
audio/manifest.json is filled by `npm run voice:record`, and every line not yet
Lesson audioPrompt values are collected from lessons.json automatically and are
deliberately not repeated here — one line, one home.
No `groups`: praise and correction come from the common pack, which names no
subject and so cannot congratulate a child on the wrong skill. `reactionPool`
pools a skill's own reactions with common's, so declaring none here is a
choice to use the shared voice rather than a gap.
